author: XtraMajestical
body: Its just a Suggestion and don't mind if it doesn't go though with but with a premium rank i believe a nice unique feature would be that if a game has just ended and then cycles onto the new map (Thats starting now) it could like inform us i'm chat so if a map like Quintes come up new everyone can go play there favorite map if theirs one starting. But only if the old map has just ended and then just cycled onto a new map it puts it to prevent your chat from spam! The message could look like this '[MCZONE01] Quintes starting soon' but not the whole starting in 30, 20 ,10, 9.... bit because that would spam your chat! Also you could have it so you can disable this if you cant and turn on certain ones like: Notifie if CTW ,TDM ,DTM ,CTH, or Survival Games is starting if you know what i mean! Thanks for reading my suggestion and this is in the 'Off Topic' part cause theres no Suggestion bit so :D

replies.author: hasl
replies.body:
Moved to server feedback
I'm not sure if I understand, but I think with Premium ranks you should go into hub and onto your 'head' or whatever you wan't to call it.
There you can click on 'Map Notifications' and from there you search for map names.
So when you're playing and for example you added 'Senex' to your list, there'll be a message saying 'Map 'Senex' is starting on server (server)'. Only you can see it.
Gold- 2 maps
Emerald- 4 maps
Diamond- 8 maps

Opinions?
